column3: “Was revealed to Isaiah” recasts the Hebrew “Isaiah saw.”
“Influences” supplies what fills them from the east.
“Rocks” is plural where the Hebrew has the singular.
“Stately vessel” gives a nautical sense to the expression for desirable objects.
“Flee” specifies going, and “shake” renders terrifying the earth.
“They will flee” expands the infinitive “to enter”; “shake” renders terrifying the earth.
“Trust” supplies the sense of ceasing from man; “only” is not expressed.
